title: ADA Immaterial (ARNG only)
raw_text:
8-13. Military Occupational Specialty 140X—ADA Immaterial (ARNG only)
    a. Licensing/certification requirement. None.
    b. Prerequisites. None.
    c. MOS 140X. MOS 140X is a non-accession Special Reporting Code (SRC) for use with
positions only. MOS 140A and 140E personnel may be utilized against SRC 140X positions at all
levels.
    d. Associated SQI.
        (1) 0--No special qualifications.
        (2) 5--Power Systems Technician.
        (3) 8--Instructor.
        (4) P--Parachutist.
        (5) Z--Research, Development, Test, and Evaluation Technician.
    e. Associated ASI.
    (1) T3--Ground-based Midcourse Defense (GMD) System.
    (2) T5--Patriot Top Gun.
    (3) 3R--Force Management.
    (4) 6M--Mobilization and Demobilization Operations.
    (5) 2N – GMD Analyst (Effective 202710)
    (6) 7Q--Training Development.
    f. Qualifications. Not applicable. SRC 140X is used for coding positions only.
    g. Duties.
         (1) WO1/CW2--
               (a) Coordinate the activities of maintenance personnel, equipment, site assets for the
installation, repair (by using Built In Test/Built In Test Equipment (BIT/BITE) and/or standard
troubleshooting procedures), maintenance, and modification of the Army BMD Systems, ancillary
equipment and tools/test equipment.
               (b) Plan, organize, implement, monitor, evaluate and supervise operations and unit
maintenance operations of BMD weapons systems.
               (c) Advise the commander on readiness.
               (d) Develop and implement maintenance SOPs.
               (e) Evaluates the effectiveness of maintenance personnel on adjustments, repair
operations and isolation procedures.
               (f) Advises and instructs maintenance personnel on the proper procedures to perform
adjustments, repair operations and fault isolation procedures.
               (g) Monitor and coordinate with higher headquarters elements and outside agencies
for the installation of modifications on BMD weapons systems.
               (h) Implement and ensure compliance with proper safety and security procedures
applicable to the BMD weapons systems.
               (i) Oversee The Army Maintenance Management System (TAMMS).
               (j) Supervise operations and maintenance of unit Prescribed Load List (PLL).
               (k) Assist platoon leaders in operator/crew training.
               (l) Acts as the commander’s representative for all aspects of unit maintenance
operations and historical records maintenance.
               (m) Supervise unit operations for Test, Measurement, and Diagnostic Equipment
(TMDE).
               (n) May perform duties as Conventional Equipment Officer.
               (o) May perform duties as unit AOAP Officer.
         (2) CW3--
               (a) Perform duties described in paragraph g(1).
               (b) Provide BMD weapons systems peculiar tactical/technical assistance and
reporting guidance and direction to subordinate elements.
               (c) Advise the commander or staff officers on BMD weapons systems capabilities and
limitations.
               (d) Evaluates, trains and validates unit readiness for the commander.
               (e) Coordinates total package fielding and the effects of modifications to the BMD
weapons systems and trains new doctrinal concepts.
              (f) Must be qualified as BMD crew member to conduct training and operational
readiness evaluations.
             (g) Conducts tactical training for crew certifications.
        (3) CW4--
             (a) Perform duties described in paragraph g(2).
             (b) Performs or oversees contract management and budgeting.
             (c) Serve as Project Manager on New/Improved weapon systems fielding.
             (d) Provide leadership, guidance, technical input and direction to subordinate
elements, staff agencies, and field commanders up to and including Brigade/Combatant
Command level.
             (e) Must be qualified as BMD crew member to conduct training and operational
readiness evaluations.
        (4) CW5--
             (a) Perform duties described in paragraph g(3).
             (b) Develop, review and update the life cycle management of BMD warrant officers.
             (c) Provide leadership, guidance, technical input and direction to subordinate
elements, staff agencies, Combatant Commanders, and interfaces with senior leadership in a
joint/combined environment.
             (d) Coordinates the activities of support personnel, manages equipment, readiness
reporting, resource management, training, and evaluations for BMD systems.
    h. Grading and position titles. The following grades are used to code positions into one of four
definable skill levels: W2 equals WO1/CW2; W3 equals CW3; W4 equals CW4; and W5 equals
CW5. The grades are listed in the following standards of grade tables:
        (1) Table 8-140X-1. Standards of grade TOE/MTOE.
        (2) Table 8-140X-2. Standards of grade TDA. (NA)

nlx_method: NLx employer-demand profiles; private-only ownership unverified. Six-digit profiles pool specialty weighted task incidences after the existing review exclusion mask and five-job task-support floor; destination SOCs require 200 postings and nonzero tasks. Military profiles use binary accepted task presence and the same NLx reference RCA weights as civilian profiles: reciprocal positive task shares (zero weight for reference-absent tasks) of pooled retained support-five NLx weighted incidences across 1,016 reference specialties (912 eligible comparison candidates), sqrt(q * rca_weight), then L2 normalization and cosine. No military crosswalk codes enter the task ranking. All positive top-20 results retained; zero-similarity destinations are not recommendations. Shared field/rating duties are included; general Naval Standards remain separate by paygrade. Summary compares non-future individual source entries (versions can repeat) with nonempty reference sets; grouped, future and general-standard entries remain in all outputs. Hit@k is the fraction with at least one reference SOC recovered; ties are averaged exactly. References outside NLx remain in denominators. DMDC reference status is from July 2024, not current 2026 status.
